Build the future of onchain security

Blockaid is a real-time onchain security platform trusted by leading wallets, exchanges, and institutions.

We are a global team with offices in New York City, Tel Aviv , Singapore, and Europe.

Unified vision, real-time impact

We’re a group of engineers, researchers, and builders aligned around one goal:

making the onchain ecosystem safer by preventing malicious behavior.

Vision

We are building a digital asset and technology ecosystem where onchain security is embedded and threats are stopped in real-time.

Mission

Our goal is to detect, understand, and prevent fraud, scams, and exploits in real-time across the onchain ecosystem.

Impact

Our real-time onchain security platform today protects 80%+ of all web3 wallets, and $300B+ in assets across 60+ chains

A culture of belonging, a bias towards action

We learn, collaborate, and deliver outcomes, and have fun doing so!

Our Open Roles

Explore open roles across engineering, research, product, sales, marketing, and operations, building real-time security for the onchain ecosystem.
